## Final QA
- [ ] #7853 On a stage with no onboarding env var, sign up with a new email. Pass: the app opens `/onboarding` and asks role, company size and source, then credits and templates.
- [ ] #7853 Pick Other on role and on source. Pass: a text field appears, Continue stays off until a line is typed, and the line survives a reload.
- [ ] #7853 Create an agent or Skip at the end. Pass: Home stays Home and does not send the user back to onboarding.
- [ ] #7853 Accept an invite as a new user into a project that already has agents. Pass: Home opens, not onboarding.
- [ ] #7853 Sign in as an existing user. Pass: Home opens as before.
- [ ] #7853 Read the new person in PostHog. Pass: `user_role_v2`, `company_size_v2` and `referral_source_v2` are single strings, and a write-in starts with `Other: `.
- [ ] #7853 On desktop, open the templates step and pick New agent. Pass: one "Describe your agent" composer, the title and chips do not move between templates, and the created agent gets the default name and renames itself from its first task.
- [ ] #7870 On a stage with Composio enabled, create an event automation (for example "New Pull Request Created" on a test repo) bound to an agent, then trigger the event. Pass: a row appears in the automation's deliveries within a minute, the run starts, and the event data reaches the agent's inputs. Events dropped before the deploy do not replay.
- [ ] #7798 On staging while it still runs v0.126.0, make an organization with two workspaces (each with a default project), and a user who is a member of the second workspace's project only (admin-created, no personal organization). Deploy. Sign in as that user on `/m`. Pass: `GET /api/projects/` answers 200 and the project list opens, no sign-in loop.
- [ ] #7798 With the same organization on `/w`: open a saved link `/w/<old workspace id>/p/<project id>/apps`. Pass: the address changes once to the organization id and the page renders. On `/m`: open `/m/w/<old workspace id>/p/<project id>/sessions`. Pass: one rewrite, no loop, a chat turn answers, and switching project in the drawer works.
- [ ] #7798 Members on `/w` and `/m` in that organization: invite, accept as the invitee, change the role, remove. Pass: each works, the pending invite shows in Members, and the project list of existing users does not change.
- [ ] #7798 API keys: a key of the project the consolidation keeps as default still updates organization settings; a key of a project that lost the default flag gets 403 there and still works in its own project. `POST /api/organizations/<org>/workspaces/` answers 410.
- [ ] #7798 Billing on staging (EE) after the migration: run an agent turn. Pass: the turn is charged and the credits screen shows the expected balance.
- [ ] #7798 After the deploy: an agent run, a channel turn, a scheduled run, and a self-managed agent turn (subscription sidecar) all work.
- [ ] #7798 Read the migration job log on each stage and region. Pass: `[053] totals` and `[ee007] totals` (or "nothing to do") appear and the job exits 0.
- [ ] #7878 On a stage with Composio enabled, create an event automation on GitHub "Pull request created", set Owner to a test org and Repo to the bare repo name, click Done and save. Pass: the saved filter is `owner/repo`, and opening a PR on that repo starts a run. Regression: an "Issue created" automation with Owner and Repo keeps the bare repo name.

## Deploy steps
- None. The PostHog "Signup 3 - Agents" survey was already updated on 2026-10-27 (see the PR body).
  Deployments that set AGENTA_ONBOARDING_FLOW_ENABLED can drop it; the app no longer reads it.
- [ ] #7798 Right before the production deploy, per region: run the read-only counts from the private rollout notes (the M4b step 2 counts, the c6b counts, and the C-1 exposure count). If any bucket that must be 0 is above 0, stop and tell the owner. Keep the numbers out of GitHub. See the PR for details.
- [ ] #7798 Per region before the deploy: dump `projects`, `workspaces`, `workspace_members` (core) and `meters` (EE). Check that staging and oss read `oss000000054` / `ee0000000006` before workflow 29. Start each regional deploy away from the usage report minutes and check that no `meters:report` lock is held. Rollback: switch the migration job off (`ALEMBIC_AUTO_MIGRATIONS=false`) before rolling images back to v0.126.0; the data changes are one way. See the PR for details.

- Reject connection or event changes on edit: fixed differently. The /m edit screen sends both, so the edit now moves the Composio trigger to the new connection and event, with a local conflict check first.

- Race between two edits: not fixed, replied. Same order as the existing is_active path; the next save resends the filters.

- Nitpick on call order in the paused test: fixed; tests record all calls in one list.
- Re-review on dc57d3968d: no new findings.

Also found while fixing: Composio PATCH returns 409 when the trigger is already in the asked state. The adapter now treats 409 as success.

All required checks green except API acceptance. First run: 873 passed, 1 read timeout and 2 setup errors with HTML error pages from the Railway preview gateway (mounts and organization secrets, not touched). The rerun ran after the preview was stopped (healthcheck failed, 857 errors in 39 s), so it proves nothing. Entire Gates is not required and had no agent findings.

## Release PR
Added two Final QA lines under #7877. No deploy steps.

## Risk
Untested against live Composio. The fix assumes the upsert takes the new trigger_config. Final QA covers it.

content.text:
PR [Agenta-AI/agenta#7877](https://github.com/Agenta-AI/agenta/pull/7877) is merged into `release/v0.127.0`. The merge SHA is `41cdb0010832d3daea4aae91b091ee347d485868`.

**What CodeRabbit raised and what I did:**
- **Composio may make a new trigger on an edit.** Composio's docs say the upsert updates a matching trigger "with the same configuration", so new filters can create a new trigger with a new id. Composio has no other call that changes filters, because its PATCH call only takes `status`. I fixed this. The edit now stores the returned trigger id, sets the paused or enabled state on it, and deletes the old trigger. If a later step fails, it deletes the new trigger instead and keeps the old one.
- **Reject connection or event changes.** I did not reject them, because the /m edit screen sends both. The edit now moves the Composio trigger to the new connection and event. If another automation already uses that connection and event, the edit fails with a conflict before it calls Composio.
- **Two edits at the same time can race.** I did not fix this, and I replied with the reason. The existing pause and start path has the same behavior, and the next save sends the filters again.
- **A step that fails after the upsert.** I fixed this for a new trigger. If Composio updated the stored trigger in place and a later step fails, the user sees an error, and saving again sends the filters again.
- **Call order in the paused test.** I fixed the test. It now checks that the disable comes after the upsert.

CodeRabbit's second review found nothing new. Entire Gates had no review findings.

**One more fix:** Composio's status call returns 409 when the trigger is already in the requested state. That happens after the upsert re-enables a trigger, so the adapter now treats 409 as success.

**Checks:** All required checks passed except API acceptance.
- The first run had 873 tests pass. It had 1 read timeout and 2 setup errors with HTML error pages from the Railway preview environment, in mount and organization-secret tests that this PR does not touch.
- I reran the failed jobs, but the rerun started after the preview environment had shut down. Its healthcheck failed and 857 tests errored in 39 seconds, so the rerun tells us nothing.
- I merged on the first run's result.

**Open risk:** Nobody has run this against live Composio. I added two lines for #7877 to the Final QA list in release PR #7875 to cover it. There are no deploy steps. I updated my row in `~/agenta-release-0127/queue.md` and wrote my notes to `~/agenta-release-0127/7877.md`.
